prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1123; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Pasadena, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of the eastbound roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that he was attempting to change lanes to the left when Vehicle 2, traveling in the adjacent lane, moved into his path, causing a sideswipe collision. Driver 2 stated that Vehicle 1 drifted into her lane without signaling. Weather was clear and the pavement was dry. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 was present but did not report injury. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and declined transport by EMS at the scene. Driver 2 reported no injuries. Both vehicles were operable and driven from the roadway. Skid marks were not observed. Lane position, damage patterns and witness statements were documented, and both drivers were issued exchange of information forms.
